source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Use this guide to run or enter a Singles event, from a small league to a world championship. It pairs the current mission deck with a common event framework. Games Workshop uses the recommendations at most of its events. Organisers can tailor them locally. The guide revises mission and table setup, corrects and clarifies mission cards, covers pairings and standings, supplies terrain setups, and lists the latest eligible model base sizes. Leave Deployment and Twist cards out of this event format. Doubles, Teams and Dominatus each have their own guide.
